pairs.subject: demo-data-plane
pairs.evidence: desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:454 The learner switcher displays the server's demo profiles as ordinary learner names without a visible demo marker, allowing fabricated identities to appear real.

techniques.evidence: desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:454 The complete learner screen renders profile names, school types and modules without identifying the default Ema and Jakub profiles as fabricated.
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:558 Although screens share the session roster, this demo identifier is handwritten without the required fabrication affix or identifier helper.

desk/src/tv/useSession.ts:23 The inspected TV path uses actual SSE and HTTP POST requests; the demo profiles are initial server records rather than a mock network client needing simulated latency and response copying.

desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:48 Profile lacks required value-level provenance: fresh() supplies demo profiles, while profile.save appends user-created profiles to the same returned collection at store.ts:720.
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:877 Missing saved session data automatically initializes the demo roster through fresh(); selection is not driven by an explicit viewer choice of a demo plane.

desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:559 The initial demo roster and tasks are handwritten constants, with no generated fixture population or series to seed; live timestamps and the actual pairing PIN serve operational behavior.
